title: Virgin Lands Campaign Soil Erosion
summary: Khrushchev's 1950s mass plowing of 40 million hectares of Kazakh and Siberian steppe converted marginal grassland to wheat fields. Within a decade, wind erosion stripped topsoil across millions of hectares, triggering dust storms comparable to the American Dust Bowl. The degraded land was largely abandoned by the 1960s, leaving a scarred, desertified landscape.
